name: Sophia van Grea
original_name: ソフィア・ファン・グレア
source:
She is a former queen of the climatically mild and prosperous kingdom of Sangrea. Her husband, the king, is murdered in a rebellion by an ambitious minister.

After fleeing with her only daughter, a baby in her arms, she ends up in the favelas of the service state. Despite her poor life, she is neither despicable nor resentful. She values chastity like a queen.

Her husband, the king, was a light-hearted man, and she is sexually inexperienced.

[From [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq40/spin.html]official site[/url]]
